data.description: Project-local coordination facts for asynchronous agents. Mutable domain records carry monotonically increasing resource versions, while auxiliary rows hold operation idempotency keys and expiring advisory resource intents. A successful transaction increments only touched resource versions and then the project change cursor. Intent ownership never grants write authority and never replaces version checks.
data.name: Resource Version and Intent Store
data.technology: SQLite per-row versions, idempotency records, expiring intent rows
